title: fix(sdk): preserve text options in raw generation
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16344

- Gives raw/plain text generation identical system messages, JSON response format, generation options, and prompt validation while retaining raw response metadata.
- Reuses one internal text-to-chat adapter for plain, raw, and streaming calls; public client signatures remain unchanged.
- Adds regressions for JSON true/false, metadata, and empty prompts: three fail before the fix; all six convenience-helper tests pass afterward.
- Verification: all 116 SDK tests, strict typecheck, ESM/CJS/browser/declaration builds, Biome, and independent focused review pass. Built-SDK native loopback confirms identical raw/plain requests. No live provider calls or Pollen used.

gist.headline: Raw text remembers its options
gist.blurb: Raw text generation keeps its instructions and options, just like plain text generation. The metadata stays along for the ride.
gist.summary: The SDK routes plain, raw, and streaming text calls through one adapter so raw generation preserves system messages, JSON response format, generation options, and prompt validation without dropping response metadata.
gist.impact: SDK developers get matching raw and plain text requests, including JSON true/false settings, while raw responses retain their metadata; public client signatures stay the same.
gist.visual_concept: The SDK has no separate mascot: depict Polli comparing two friendly retro terminals labeled PLAIN and RAW, each showing matching JSON settings, with the RAW terminal also carrying a small metadata tag; code-plants connect the terminals to suggest their shared adapter.
